title: consolidate-pricing-tiers-execution-billing-verification
creator: Aisha Gupta
description: Goal: Consolidate four legacy pricing tiers into two streamlined SKUs, implement soft limits with migration grace periods, and validate end-to-end billing accuracy before public cutover. Scope includes SKU mapping logic, entitlement migration job, billing reconciliation tests, customer-facing comms, sales enablement, and release notes coordination. Out of scope: pricing strategy changes (approved separately) and account-level negotiated entitlements which will be handled post-launch via sales ops. Success looks like: all new customers assigned correct consolidated SKU, historical accounts have preserved entitlements or documented exceptions, billing runs reconcile to expected revenue delta (+/- 0.5%), and support surge is below 2% ticket increase for first 7 days.
acceptance_criteria: SKU mapping script runs on staging and produces mapping report with zero unmapped accounts
Billing reconciliation report shows aggregated token billing within +/-0.5% of expected baseline
Customer comms templates (email + in-console banner + FAQ) approved by legal and support
Sales enablement playbook published and trimmed to 2-page cheat sheet
Release notes drafted, reviewed by eng and legal, and scheduled in product blog with link back to FAQ
tasks: Finalize SKU mapping table and edge-case rules (overrides, legacy entitlements)
Build and smoke-test entitlement migration tool on staging cluster
Run two dry-run billing cycles in sandbox and reconcile to baseline metrics
Coordinate release notes and in-console copy with docs and comms teams
Produce sales enablement deck and run internal training session
Create cutover runbook with explicit rollback triggers and owner list
Schedule support on-call rotations for D+0..D+7 and prepare canned responses

rollout_plan_summary: Phase 1: Pilot migration for 5% of accounts (non-enterprise, low-volume) and validate billing for 48 hours. Phase 2: Ramp to 50% mid-window after automated reconciliation checks pass. Phase 3: Full cutover outside of maintenance window with in-console banners and email comms. Post-cutover: 7-day monitoring window with daily reconciliation reports and support escalation paths.
rollback_plan_summary: Criteria to rollback: billing variance >1% after two reconciliation cycles, >5% of pilot accounts reporting incorrect entitlements, or critical payment failures affecting invoice generation. Rollback steps: pause migration job, run entitlement reversion for affected accounts, revert billing run to previous SKU logic, and notify customers. Owners: Eng on rollback execution, Revenue Ops on invoice reprocessing, Support on customer notifications.
risks: Large account overrides not captured by mapping rules
Multi-currency rounding producing delta in aggregated billing
Support load higher than projected due to confusing comms
audit_steps: Run before/after token usage aggregation for pilot cohort and store CSV artifacts
Validate invoice line-items for 100 random pilot accounts across currencies
Confirm revenue impact model updated in internal finance workbook
Log migration job outputs to S3 for 90 days and snapshot entitlement DB prior to cutover
